Connect your repository

Stories, photographs and archived articles are saved to your GitHub repository.

Restrict the token to this repository, with Contents and Actions read/write. It stays in memory only and is cleared on reload or disconnect.

First-time setup and draft privacy

Follow START-HERE.md in the package. Set Pages to GitHub Actions and allow the workflow to write repository contents. GitHub validates every read and write.

Drafts are excluded from the website, but remain readable by repository collaborators. In a public repository, drafts and import notes are public source files. Do not save confidential material here.

Upload photographs

Up to 12 images per upload, 20 MB each. Images are resized to 1,800 pixels and stored as WebP. Batch captions can be edited individually afterwards.

Import a published article

Paste a public article URL, then choose its section and how it should be counted.

Original bylines remain unchanged. Bylined articles count with your bylined work; non-byline work has a separate total. Paywalls and access restrictions are not bypassed.

Import status

Manage stories

Daily Star refresh

Scheduled checks run every 20 minutes. Every valid article listed on your Daily Star author pages is published automatically; no review queue is required. Older pages are explored progressively while recent work is checked first.

Each run saves a bounded batch, then later runs continue the backlog until the author listing is complete. Saved stories are never removed because the source disappears. Failed extracts are logged below.
